    # record is that it rested on "four games read in source, which is an observation, not
    # a field", and that whether a decline is written at full length and PAID is a
    # judgement no parser makes. Both still hold, and the quality half stays ungated. What
    # this gates is strictly narrower and countable — is there a single choice in the whole
    # game that declines an offer — and it rests on the whole corpus, not on four games.
    #
    # WHAT THIS CATCHES: a game the player cannot decline anything in. An author can
    # write two hundred choices without ever noticing they never wrote a no.
    #
    # THE FIELD: 1,763 of 84,458 clickable labels across the 25 corpus games are a real
    # refusal — 2.09%, roughly one click in fifty. And they are NOT theatre, which was
    # checked before this gate was written: of 4,973 refusals sitting beside at least one
    # other option, 79% go somewhere the accepting link does not, the median destination
    # carries 262 words, and only 3% lead to a stub under 20. In the field, declining buys
    # content. Refusal is a content kind, not a courtesy.
    #
    # ⚠️ FAILS ONLY ON ZERO, on the precedent of G44 and G45. A rate floor cannot be
    # defended from here: the field's 2.09% is not the same measurement — field labels
    # include navigation, and this reads authored choice text. Zero needs no threshold. It is the defect by definition, and everything above
    # zero is reported so a distribution can accumulate and a future floor be READ off it
    # rather than invented. That restraint is what R4, study 6's anchoring check and P0
    # were withdrawn for missing.
    #
    # ⚠️ THE PATTERN IS NARROW ON PURPOSE, AND THE FIRST DRAFT WAS WRONG. A looser one
    # counted `leave` and `ignore`, which are navigation — "Leave the shop" declines
    # nothing, so it reads navigation as refusal. A refusal DECLINES AN OFFER; anything
    # that merely exits a room is not one. If this gate is ever loosened, re-check it
    # against games with known refusals first.
    # ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # CK8a (I3): a no written as her spoken line starts with a quote mark — skip it.
    # The pattern lives at module level as `_REFUSAL_RE` since NC3 (PRD v2 phase 4), which

    _ch_texts = [ch.get("text") for c in (game.get("canvases") or [])

114	## A3 · Saying no — parked by default, final only when the button says so
115	
116	**One rule** (LO decided, D6; R2 K7):
117	
118	- **An ordinary no is parked.** The step comes back after the author's wait (`retry_after_days` on the
119	  no, with the step's trigger set to `consume_on = "exit"`, `engine.md` §49), and his next line may remember it:
120	  a pushy man says so, a nice man drops it.
121	- **A final no exists only on a button that says so** — "(ends his path)" — and sets `final = true`.
122	  It closes his story, never the person: he stays in the world.
123	- **Where a game gives him feelings** (`the-meters.md` W1), a no may cost Warmth, never Want (R5).
124	
125	> ⚠️ **EVIDENCE — NOT A TEMPLATE.** In-scene lines from the passing games:
126	>
127	> - the nice man drops it — In Her Own Hands [ShaunBRTalk4D]: *"I get it," Shaun said quickly. "It's
128	>   totally cool."*
129	> - the pushy man asks again — Cupid's Way [damien13]: *"Haha, alright."*, and the same ask is back
130	>   on her City screen as soon as she leaves;
131	> - he remembers — In Her Own Hands [JamesCoffeeShop2E]: *"my texts and calls seemed to vanish into
132	>   thin air"*; [DevDadDiner1]: *"You haven't called. Naughty girl . . ."*;
133	> - the final no is labelled — the same passage: *"End the conversation and get back to work (ends
134	>   path)"*.
135	
136	Remembering a no in his words is **thin**: 2 men in 1 game of 4 (R2 K7). None of the four passing
137	games routes a refusal to a new person, so a no never hands her on. **The one thing a no never does
138	is stay silent about which kind it is.**
139	
140	---

142	## A4 · The step raises the number that opens the step after it — and only while she is under it
143	
144	**The shape:** the scene grants the meter it is gated on, capped at the next threshold, so
145	repeating a scene at the bottom walks the player up it. The climb is fed by the content it
146	opens, not only bought elsewhere.
147	
148	`the-meters.md` M1–M5 owns the other half of this — every meter a gate reads carries a brake on
149	the rungs that raise it. **This is the same seam from the other side, and the two must be read
150	together or the result is either a free elevator or a wall.**

152	> ⚠️ **EVIDENCE — NOT A TEMPLATE.** `course-of-temptation`, the night she overhears her roommate
153	> and his partner — one scene, five pages. Each page offers **exactly two buttons**: one step
154	> further, gated on a skill (*Listen in* at Voyeurism 1, *Sneak a look* at 2, *Touch yourself* at
155	> Disinhibition 2, *Finish yourself off* at 4), or stop (*"Rein it in!"*, a willpower check).
156	> Taking the gated step raises the skill that gated it, so listening is what makes her able to
157	> look. Where she is short, the game prints the bar: *"(Need Exhibitionism 4)"*. `shady-deals`
158	> states a locked door the same way: *"You can't launch an orgy, you need more girls working in
159	> here."*
160	>
161	> Two refinements have one example, in one game (`family-ties`, numbers only), on top of the +1
162	> unit (`the-meters.md` W1b-i): the grant is scaled by where she already is (+5 below 30, +10
163	> above), and the raise stops at the next threshold, so she cannot climb past a rung by repeating
164	> the one below it.
165	
166	Two exits per page is the whole navigation of a five-page scene. Compare the act-menu figures

# NC3 · a no has content (D6) — `the-arc.md` A3, `engine.md` §49.
# Judged only on canvases that opted into EN1 (`consume_on = "exit"`); anywhere else the
# step is used up when its first screen shows, and there is no parked no to judge.
#   · every exit that LEAVES the step without consuming it — a choice to a location, or to
#     a node from which no path reaches a consuming choice — must carry `retry_after_days`
#     or `final = true`, or lead to a node of this canvas that has text AND something the
#     no changes: an effect or a flag on the choice or on that node's exits, or a
#     `retry_after_days` there. A bare "Walk out" to a location is the failure.
#   · not judged: a node-to-node choice inside the yes path ("Kiss him" on screen 2 of a
#     3-screen yes), and any choice on a node reached only after a consuming choice.
#   · a `final = true` exit's label says it ends the path.
# The CK8a refusal pattern (`_REFUSAL_RE`) names each exit as a no or a way out in the list.
# CK8a (I3): a no written as her spoken line starts with a quote mark — skip it.
_REFUSAL_RE = re.compile(
    r"^[\s\"“'‘]*(no[,.!\s\"”'’]|no$|refuse|decline|say no|reject|resist|turn (him|her|it|them) down|"
    r"don't|do not|not (tonight|now|today|this)|push (him|her|them) (off|away)|"
    r"stop (him|her|them)|pull away|shake your head|tell (him|her|them) no|"
    r"back off|not interested|keep (them|it) on|refuse to)", re.I)
_FINAL_LABEL_RE = re.compile(r"\bend|for good|\(ends", re.I)


def _no_has_content(game):
    """(ok, headline, detail, n) for `a no has content`."""
    opted = [c for c in (game.get("canvases") or [])
             if not _is_dev(c) and (c.get("trigger") or {}).get("consume_on") == "exit"]
    if not opted:
        return None, ("no canvas opts into consume_on = \"exit\" (EN1) — n/a until a step does; "
                      "then a bare \"Walk out\" is caught"), [], 0
    bad, judged = [], 0

    def changes(h):
        return bool(h.get("effects") or h.get("flagEffects") or h.get("retry_after_days"))

    for c in opted:
        nodes = {n.get("id"): n for n in c.get("nodes") or []}

        def target(ch):
            if ch.get("targetType") == "location":
                return None
            return nodes.get(str(ch.get("nodeId") or "").split(".")[-1])

        # Nodes from which a consuming choice can be reached through node-to-node choices.
        reaches = {i for i, n in nodes.items() if any(ch.get("consumes") for ch in _node_choices(n))}
        grew = True
        while grew:
            grew = False
            for i, n in nodes.items():
                if i not in reaches and any((t := target(ch)) is not None and t.get("id") in reaches
                                            for ch in _node_choices(n) if not ch.get("consumes")):
                    reaches.add(i)
                    grew = True
        # Nodes on screen before the step is used: from the entry, never through a consume.
        first = (c.get("nodes") or [{}])[0].get("id")
        before, todo = set(), [first]
        while todo:
            i = todo.pop()
            if i in before or i not in nodes:
                continue
            before.add(i)
            for ch in _node_choices(nodes[i]):

## 49. A one-time step is used on its yes — `consume_on`

**Opt-in (EN1, 2026-09-30).** By default a one-time canvas is used up when its first screen shows, so a
no on screen 2 can never come back. With `consume_on = "exit"` on the trigger, the step is used only by

[canvases.trigger]
consume_on       = "exit"
retry_after_days = 2          # the wait when she leaves without deciding (default 1)

consumes = true               # the yes: the step is used up
final    = true               # the warned no: used up, and sets the flag <canvas>_closed

# Map: two_hub. Two roots joined by the bus: linden_street (the house: hall, kitchen, study,
# upstairs with four rooms) and downtown
# (the firm, the hotel bar, the Velvet Room). Downtown is sealed: only the bus reaches it.
# =============================================================================

[player]
id           = "player"
name         = "Emma"
description  = "Emma, 21. First week as an intern at Callahan Reed."
customizable = false

[player.core_traits]
money        = 20
energy       = 100
nerve        = 0
office_talk  = 0
martin_stage = 0
ethan_stage  = 0
theo_stage   = 0
jade_stage   = 0

# ── Linden Street — the ground the house sits on ─────────────────────────────
[[locations]]
id                   = "linden_street"
name                 = "Linden Street"
kind                 = "thoroughfare"
description          = "A quiet suburban street of lawns and hedges. Martin's house is the big one with the black car in the drive. The bus stop into town is at the corner."
image                = "locations/linden_street.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["suburban street houses lawns morning", "bus stop suburban corner"]
navigation_order     = ["house"]

[[locations]]
id                   = "house"
name                 = "Home"
kind                 = "thoroughfare"   # the front hall: it only routes (the-map.md R2)
description          = "The front hall of Martin's house. The kitchen is straight ahead, Martin's study is off to the side, and the stairs go up to the bedrooms and the bathroom."
image                = "locations/house_hall.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["suburban house front hall staircase", "family home entrance hallway stairs evening"]
entry_from           = "linden_street"
navigation_order     = ["kitchen", "landing", "study"]

[[locations]]
id                   = "kitchen"
name                 = "The Kitchen"
description          = "The kitchen: the big table where the family eats breakfast and dinner. On Fridays Martin sits at the head of it and waits for his envelope."
image                = "locations/kitchen.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["family kitchen table morning suburban", "modern kitchen dinner table evening"]
entry_from           = "house"

# =============================================================================
# Billable Hours — 4 · the ladder steps (SP2) and the guidance cards
# Each step: one-time, `consume_on = "exit"` (a no parks it, engine.md §49), trigger
# window = the ledger's `when`, conditions = the ledger's gate + the counter at N−1.
# Martin's want is capped at 14 in v0.1 (NOTES.md): his step-3 door stays locked.
# =============================================================================

# ── Martin · step 1 · the first Friday ───────────────────────────────────────
[[canvases]]
id   = "martin_01_first_friday"
name = "Friday in the study"
description = "Martin step 1. He already has the money (the rent page, breakfast). He reads her pay stub: \"Sit.\""

[canvases.trigger]
location         = "study"
requires_npc     = "npc_martin"
is_repeatable    = false
priority         = 10
is_active        = true
consume_on       = "exit"
retry_after_days = 7

[[canvases.trigger.schedules]]
weekdays   = [4]
start_time = "19:00"
end_time   = "22:00"

[canvases.trigger.conditions]
version = "1.0"
logic   = "AND"
items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "martin_stage", operator = "eq", value = 0 } ]

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "door"
name = "Friday"
blocks = [
  { type = "image", props = { file = "scenes/martin_01_study.jpg", description = "A lamp-lit home study, an older man in a leather armchair with a glass of whisky", search_queries = ["older man leather armchair study lamp whisky", "home study evening armchair man suit"] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "Martin's study door is open for once. He's in the leather armchair with a glass of whisky, and he doesn't get up." },
  { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Come in, Emma. Shut the door." },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "You shut it. He already has this week's envelope. He took it at breakfast. So you don't know what this is." },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "choices"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Wait for him to say it."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "martin_01_first_friday.stub"

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "stub"
name = "The pay stub"
blocks = [
  { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Your pay stub. Let me see it." },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "You hand it over. He reads it slowly, the way Callahan reads a contract." },
  { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Seventy a day. I want to see what Callahan thinks you're worth. Sit." },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He pats the arm of his chair. It is not a question. Your stomach drops, and your feet are already moving." },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "choices"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text             = "Stay standing by the desk."
targetType       = "node"
nodeId           = "martin_01_first_friday.parked"
retry_after_days = 7
flagEffects = [ { targetType = "player", flag = "martin_friday_parked", op = "set" } ]
effects     = [ { targetType = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin", trait = "martin_power", op = "add", value = 5, clamp = true } ]

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Sit on the arm of his chair, hands in your lap."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "martin_01_first_friday.sat1"
consumes   = true
flagEffects = [ { targetType = "player", flag = "martin_friday_sat", op = "set" } ]
effects = [
  { targetType = "player", trait = "martin_stage", op = "set", value = 1 },
  { targetType = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin", trait = "martin_want", op = "add", value = 5, cap = 14 },
]

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Sit on the arm and lean into his shoulder."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "martin_01_first_friday.sat2"
consumes   = true
flagEffects = [ { targetType = "player", flag = "martin_friday_sat", op = "set" } ]
effects = [
  { targetType = "player", trait = "martin_stage", op = "set", value = 1 },
  { targetType = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin", trait = "martin_want", op = "add", value = 5, cap = 14 },
  { targetType = "player", trait = "nerve", op = "add", value = 1, cap = 10 },
]

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Sit, and leave his hand where it lands."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "martin_01_first_friday.sat3"
consumes   = true
conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "nerve", operator = "gte", value = 5 } ] }
flagEffects = [
  { targetType = "player", flag = "martin_friday_sat",  op = "set" },
  { targetType = "player", flag = "martin_friday_knee", op = "set" },
]
effects = [
  { targetType = "player", trait = "martin_stage", op = "set", value = 1 },
  { targetType = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin", trait = "martin_want", op = "add", value = 5, cap = 14 },
  { targetType = "player", trait = "nerve", op = "add", value = 2, cap = 10 },
]

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Put the stub on his desk and go. (ends his path)"
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "martin_01_first_friday.final"
final      = true

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "sat1"
name = "On the arm of his chair"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "You perch on the arm of his chair with your hands folded in your lap like a schoolteacher is watching. He reads. He doesn't touch you. The whole room is the smell of his whisky and the tick of his watch." },
  { type = "thought_bubble", props = { speaker = "player" }, content = "It's all there. You can count it." },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "choices"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Stay while he reads."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "martin_01_first_friday.diane"

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "sat2"
name = "Against his shoulder"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "You sit on the arm and lean into his shoulder. He smells of whisky and aftershave. He doesn't look up from the stub, but his hand settles on your knee. It stays there. It's warm and heavy, and you can feel every one of his fingers through your tights. You don't move it." },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "choices"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Stay while he reads."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "martin_01_first_friday.diane"

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "sat3"
name = "His hand"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "You sit, and his hand lands on your knee like it was always going to. You leave it there. You shift so your skirt rides an inch higher, and his thumb moves once, slow, over the inside of your knee. Your whole body goes hot." },
  { type = "thought_bubble", props = { speaker = "player" }, content = "Read it slowly. I'm in no hurry." },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "choices"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Stay while he reads."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "martin_01_first_friday.diane"

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "diane"
name = "A knock"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "Someone knocks. Your mother comes in with his coffee and stops. Then she smiles, wide and relieved." },
  { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "Look at you two. I knew you'd come round to him." },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "She puts the cup down and goes. You hear her on the stairs, going up, not coming back." },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "choices"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Watch the door close."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "martin_01_first_friday.close"
flagEffects = [ { targetType = "player", flag = "diane_blessed_fridays", op = "set" } ]

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "close"
name = "The door clicks shut"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "The door clicks shut behind her. Martin's hand hasn't moved." },
  { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Your mother thinks this is sweet." },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He folds the stub and hands it back to you." },
  { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Callahan will ask me about you. What should I tell him?" },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "location"
text = "Go up to bed."

[canvases.nodes.exit_block.config]
destinationType          = "specific"
locationId               = "her_room"
time_progression_minutes = 30

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "parked"
name = "Next Friday"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "You stay by the desk. You expect him to be angry, but he only looks at you for a long moment and smiles like you've told him something." },
  { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Next Friday, then." },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "location"
text = "Go up to bed."

[canvases.nodes.exit_block.config]
destinationType          = "specific"
locationId               = "her_room"
time_progression_minutes = 30

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "final"
name = "A transaction"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "You put the stub on his desk and walk out. He doesn't call you back. From now on Friday is an envelope at breakfast, and nothing else." },
  { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Goodnight, Emma." },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "location"
text = "Go up to bed."

[canvases.nodes.exit_block.config]
destinationType          = "specific"
locationId               = "her_room"
time_progression_minutes = 30

# ── Martin · step 2 · nobody knocks ──────────────────────────────────────────
[[canvases]]
id   = "martin_02_nobody_knocks"
name = "Friday, and nobody knocks"
description = "Martin step 2. Diane stays upstairs now. His hand is on her knee before she answers."

[canvases.trigger]
location         = "study"
requires_npc     = "npc_martin"
is_repeatable    = false
priority         = 10
is_active        = true
consume_on       = "exit"
retry_after_days = 7

[[canvases.trigger.schedules]]
weekdays   = [4]
start_time = "19:00"
end_time   = "22:00"

[canvases.trigger.conditions]
version = "1.0"
logic   = "AND"
items = [
  { type = "flag",  subject = "player", flag_key = "martin_friday_sat", operator = "is_true" },
  { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "martin_stage", operator = "eq", value = 1 },
]

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "door"
name = "Your chair's free"
blocks = [
  { type = "image", props = { file = "scenes/martin_02_study.jpg", description = "A man's hand resting on a young woman's knee, office skirt, lamplight", search_queries = ["man hand on woman knee office skirt lamplight", "armchair study couple evening tease"] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "Friday again. The house is quiet. Your mother went upstairs with her tea straight after dinner." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "martin_friday_knee", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Your chair's free. You didn't move your knee last time." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "npc", npc_id = "npc_martin", trait_key = "martin_power", operator = "gte", value = 5 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Your chair's free. You made me wait a week, Emma. Don't do it again." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Your chair's free." },
  ] } },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "choices"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Sit."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "martin_02_nobody_knocks.knee"

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "knee"
name = "What did Callahan say"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "You sit on the arm. His hand is on your knee before you've settled, like it's his." },
  { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "What did Callahan say about you this week?" },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "office_talk", operator = "gte", value = 3 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Because his associates talk about you. I'd rather they didn't." },
  ] } },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "choices"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Tell him the truth."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "martin_02_nobody_knocks.thigh"
consumes   = true
effects = [
  { targetType = "player", trait = "martin_stage", op = "set", value = 2 },
  { targetType = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin", trait = "martin_want", op = "add", value = 5, cap = 14 },
  { targetType = "player", trait = "nerve", op = "add", value = 1, cap = 15 },
]

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Tell him what he wants to hear."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "martin_02_nobody_knocks.thigh"
consumes   = true
show_when_locked = true
conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "nerve", operator = "gte", value = 10 } ] }
effects = [
  { targetType = "player", trait = "martin_stage", op = "set", value = 2 },
  { targetType = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin", trait = "martin_want", op = "add", value = 5, cap = 14 },
  { targetType = "player", trait = "nerve", op = "add", value = 2, cap = 15 },
]

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text             = "Stand up. Not tonight."
targetType       = "node"
nodeId           = "martin_02_nobody_knocks.parked"
retry_after_days = 7
effects = [ { targetType = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin", trait = "martin_power", op = "add", value = 5, clamp = true } ]

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "thigh"
name = "His hand moves"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "You answer, and while you're answering his hand moves up. Off your knee, onto your thigh, under the hem of your skirt. It stops there, warm, his thumb resting on the inside of your leg. You don't stop talking. You don't stop him either, and you can hear your own breathing." },
  { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Good. Same time next Friday. Bring the stub. Leave the jacket downstairs." },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "location"
text = "Go up to bed."

[canvases.nodes.exit_block.config]

time_progression_minutes = 30

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "parked"
name = "Not tonight"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "You stand up. His hand falls away. He picks up his glass like nothing happened." },
  { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Next Friday." },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "location"
text = "Go up to bed."

[canvases.nodes.exit_block.config]
destinationType          = "specific"
locationId               = "her_room"
time_progression_minutes = 30

# ── Martin · step 3 · THE DOOR (locked all of v0.1) ──────────────────────────
[[canvases]]
id   = "martin_03_jacket_downstairs"

description = "Martin step 3 and the release's door. The canvas fires every Friday after step 2; the door choice is locked on his want (15). v0.1 caps his want at 14."

[canvases.trigger]
location         = "study"
requires_npc     = "npc_martin"

# ── Martin at breakfast — the leak, and his want +1 a day (capped at 14 in v0.1)
[[canvases]]
id   = "hub_martin_breakfast"
name = "Martin at breakfast"
description = "Martin's hub. The leak by stage; reads her outfit and Ethan's face. Raises his want +1 a day, cap 14."

[canvases.trigger]
location      = "kitchen"
npc           = "npc_martin"
requires_npc  = "npc_martin"
is_repeatable = true
priority      = 6
is_active     = true

[canvases.trigger.conditions]
version = "1.0"
logic   = "AND"
items = [
  { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "opening_done",    operator = "is_true" },
  { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "breakfast_today", operator = "is_false" },
]

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "table"
name = "Breakfast"
blocks = [
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "time_of_day", start_time = "07:00", end_time = "08:30" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "Martin pours your coffee without asking how you take it. He already knows." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "Martin is at the kitchen table with a whisky and a stack of files. He moves the chair beside him out with his foot." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He looks at you like he's already decided something." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "martin_stage", operator = "gte", value = 2 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "The jacket, Emma. Friday." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "martin_stage", operator = "eq", value = 1 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Your chair's free on Friday." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Friday, Emma." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He looks at you over the top of his glasses." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "worn_corruption", operator = "gte", value = 2 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His eyes go down your tight blouse and stay there long enough that your mother clears her throat at the stove." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His eyes stay on you a beat too long, and then he turns the page." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "Behind you your mother moves around the kitchen, humming." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "ethan_saw_front", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "Ethan is staring at his plate like it's a contract." },
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Something wrong with your eggs, Ethan?" },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He reaches past you for the milk." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "theo_hour_paid", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Crisp notes in your envelope this week. Resourceful. I won't ask where from. Not yet." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "He turns back to his reading." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He finishes his coffee." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "npc", npc_id = "npc_martin", trait_key = "martin_want", operator = "gte", value = 10 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His hand rests on the back of your chair, and then on your shoulder, and stays there while he reads. He doesn't bother hiding it from the room any more." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His arm brushes yours and he doesn't apologise." },
  ] } },
]

[canvases.trigger]
location      = "kitchen"

[canvases.trigger.conditions]

items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "opening_done", operator = "is_true" } ]

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "talk"
name = "Your mother"
blocks = [
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "office_talk", operator = "gte", value = 3 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "People at the firm talk, sweetheart. Don't give them anything to talk about. Martin's name is on that door." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "diane_blessed_fridays", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "I love that you and Martin have your Fridays now. It means a lot to him. It means a lot to me." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "Are you eating properly? You look tired. Is Callahan being fair to you?" },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "She pats the chair next to hers at the table." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "martin_stage", operator = "gte", value = 2 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "You and Martin were up so late on Friday. He came to bed humming. I haven't seen him like that in years." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "The TV on the counter murmurs." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "parents_bed_used", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [

# ── Martin at breakfast — the leak, and his want +1 a day (capped at 14 in v0.1)
[[canvases]]
id   = "hub_martin_breakfast"
name = "Martin at breakfast"
description = "Martin's hub. The leak by stage; reads her outfit and Ethan's face. Raises his want +1 a day, cap 14."

[canvases.trigger]
location      = "kitchen"
npc           = "npc_martin"
requires_npc  = "npc_martin"

[canvases.trigger.conditions]
version = "1.0"

items = [
  { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "opening_done",    operator = "is_true" },
  { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "breakfast_today", operator = "is_false" },
]

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "table"
name = "Breakfast"
blocks = [
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "time_of_day", start_time = "07:00", end_time = "08:30" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "Martin pours your coffee without asking how you take it. He already knows." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "Martin is at the kitchen table with a whisky and a stack of files. He moves the chair beside him out with his foot." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He looks at you like he's already decided something." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "martin_stage", operator = "gte", value = 2 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "The jacket, Emma. Friday." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "martin_stage", operator = "eq", value = 1 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Your chair's free on Friday." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Friday, Emma." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He looks at you over the top of his glasses." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "worn_corruption", operator = "gte", value = 2 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His eyes go down your tight blouse and stay there long enough that your mother clears her throat at the stove." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His eyes stay on you a beat too long, and then he turns the page." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "Behind you your mother moves around the kitchen, humming." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "ethan_saw_front", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "Ethan is staring at his plate like it's a contract." },
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Something wrong with your eggs, Ethan?" },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He reaches past you for the milk." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "theo_hour_paid", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Crisp notes in your envelope this week. Resourceful. I won't ask where from. Not yet." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "He turns back to his reading." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He finishes his coffee." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "npc", npc_id = "npc_martin", trait_key = "martin_want", operator = "gte", value = 10 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His hand rests on the back of your chair, and then on your shoulder, and stays there while he reads. He doesn't bother hiding it from the room any more." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His arm brushes yours and he doesn't apologise." },
  ] } },
]

# ── Diane in the evening ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[[canvases]]
id   = "hub_diane_home"
name = "Your mother"
description = "Diane's hub at home. Worried; reads office talk and whether Fridays are 'sweet'."

[canvases.trigger]
location      = "kitchen"
npc           = "npc_diane"
requires_npc  = "npc_diane"
is_repeatable = true
priority      = 6
is_active     = true

[canvases.trigger.conditions]
version = "1.0"
logic   = "AND"
items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "opening_done", operator = "is_true" } ]

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "talk"
name = "Your mother"
blocks = [
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "office_talk", operator = "gte", value = 3 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "People at the firm talk, sweetheart. Don't give them anything to talk about. Martin's name is on that door." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "diane_blessed_fridays", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "I love that you and Martin have your Fridays now. It means a lot to him. It means a lot to me." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "Are you eating properly? You look tired. Is Callahan being fair to you?" },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "She pats the chair next to hers at the table." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "martin_stage", operator = "gte", value = 2 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "You and Martin were up so late on Friday. He came to bed humming. I haven't seen him like that in years." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "The TV on the counter murmurs." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "parents_bed_used", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "Martin says I've started making his side of the bed too neatly. I haven't touched it." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "She squeezes your hand." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "review_passed", operator = "is_false" }, { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "review_failed", operator = "is_false" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "Week twelve, sweetheart. I've told everyone you'll be kept on. Don't let me down." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "review_failed", operator = "is_true" }, { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "review_passed", operator = "is_false" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "Probation. I told everyone it was a formality, sweetheart. Make it one." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "Kept on. I told everyone you would be. Now go and get that contract signed." },
  ] } },
]

type = "choices"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
